Name: Kenneth's Grocery Store
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b][size=4]Kenneth's Grocery Store[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Adds 350 grocery items to Stardew Valley.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]What is inside[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]- Groceries like Packaged American Cheese Slices, Packaged Raw Bacon, Can of Baking Powder, Bunch of Ripe Bananas, Bottle of Barbecue Sauce, Mixed Bell Peppers, Red Box of Butter, Blue Box of Butter Sticks, Green Cabbage, Chocolate Candy Bar, Orange and Blue Boxes of Cereal, Brown Bag of Coffee Beans, Bag of Chocolate Chip Cookies, Bottle of Cooking Oil and more[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Household items like Small Metal Shopping Basket, Yellow Shopping Basket, Brown Paper Shopping Bag, Roll of Aluminum Foil, Blue Ballpoint Pen, Box of Adhesive Bandages, Spray Bottle Bathroom Cleaner, Pack of AA Batteries, Bottle of Body Lotion, Empty Gray Mixing Bowl, Pack of Bubble Gum, Wooden Chopping Board, Cleaning Brush, Cleaning Gloves, Credit Cards and more[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Seafood like Pile of Black Mussels, Sandy Oysters, Pink Scallops and more[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Items like Empty Gray Mixing Bowl - needed to buy seafood via trade[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- All items can be turned on or off in GMCM[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Where to buy[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]All items are sold in Kenneth's Grocery Store building. The building has 5 shops inside with different selections.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]This store is the main ingredient source for my other mods like Kenneth's Bakery, Kenneth's Dessert Shop, etc.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Building Note[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Content Patcher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for toggling items[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- DSS[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Works with most content mods.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Made by Kf29 aka Kenneth[/size][/b]
